name: garmin-claude-worker
description: Ask Claude about your Garmin sleep and HRV from any device. Runs in your own Cloudflare account on Garmin's official Personal API.

GARMIN_PERSONAL_API_KEY.description: Your Garmin **Personal API key**. Create it at [Garmin Connect > Settings > Personal API Key](https://connect.garmin.com/app/settings/personalApiToken). Stored as a secret in *your* Cloudflare account.

MCP_TOKEN.description: A long random password you choose. Claude must send it to read your data. Keep a copy: you paste it into Claude in the next step.

TOKENS.description: Caches Garmin's 24-hour access token. Leave as is.
